# Lowry's Crab Shack
> Loudoun County's beloved roadside seafood crab shack serving fresh steamed Chesapeake Bay blue crabs, 4-time voted #1 fried chicken, and homemade Maryland Smith Island cakes.

- **Name**: Lowry's Crab Shack LLC
- **Proprietors**: Donald & Leslie Lowry (son Marshall Lowry, continuing the legacy of Rudy Williams)
- **Location**: 420 W Colonial Highway, Hamilton, VA 20158
- **Coordinates**: 39.1365958, -77.6726042
- **Phone**: (540) 338-2348
- **Email**: info@lowryscrabshack.com
- **Online Ordering (Talech)**: https://microsite.talech.com/ordering/Lowry-s-Crab-Shack-Hamilton-VA/566610
- **Core Specialties**: Live Chesapeake Bay blue crabs steamed fresh to order with cider vinegar, beer, and Old Bay; 4-time Voted #1 Fried Chicken in Loudoun County (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024); Spiced peel-and-eat steamed shrimp; Jumbo lump crab cakes; Soft shell crabs; Homemade broccoli bacon salad; Traditional multi-layer Maryland Smith Island cakes.
- **Amenities**: Covered outdoor picnic pavilion, dog-friendly outdoor grassy yard, child play area, outdoor crab hand-washing sinks, motorcycle group friendly, indoor air-conditioned dining, hot bushel carryout packaging.
- **Hours**: Wed – Fri: 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM; Sat & Sun: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM; Mon & Tue: Closed (Watermen Harvest Rest).
